<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {

    /**
     * Helper to clone a specific source and move it to a specific target
     */
    function pairTooltip(sourceSelector, targetIndex, coords) {
        const source = document.querySelector(sourceSelector);
        const target = document.querySelector(`[data-section-id="{{ section.id }}"] a[data-index="${targetIndex}"]`);
console.log(source);
        if (source && target) {
            // 1. Prepare Target
            target.style.position = 'relative';
            target.style.display = 'block';
            target.style.width = '100%';

            // 2. Clone and Clean
            const newTooltip = source.cloneNode(true);
            const pText = newTooltip.querySelector('p');
            if (pText) pText.remove();

            // 3. Style and Position
            Object.assign(newTooltip.style, {
                position: 'absolute',
                zIndex: '10',
                margin: '0',
                pointerEvents: 'auto',
                cursor: 'pointer',
                minWidth: '15px',
                left: coords.left,
                top: coords.top,
                width: coords.width
            });

            // 4. Interaction
            newTooltip.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();
            });

            target.appendChild(newTooltip);
        } else {
            console.warn(`Tooltip pairing failed for index: ${targetIndex}. Source or Target not found.`);
        }
    }

    // --- PAIR 1 ---
    // Target: Image Index 1
    pairTooltip('[data-section-id="{{ section.id }}"] .block-tooltip:nth-of-type(1) > div', "0", {
        left: '30%',
        top: '3.5%',
        width: '2.85%'
    });

    // --- PAIR 2 ---
    // Target: Image Index 10
    pairTooltip('[data-section-id="{{ section.id }}"] .block-tooltip:nth-of-type(7) > div', "8", {
        left: '30%', 
        top: '3.5%',
        width: '2.85%'
    });

    // 5. Final Re-initialization
    if (typeof initTooltips === "function") {
        initTooltips();
    }
});
</script>

<style>
#shopify-section-{{section.id}} [data-tooltip-bg] > img {aspect-ratio: 1 !important;}
</style>
